37/* @brief Meaning of one tensor dimension.
38 * Labels are empty or contain one entry per element. Units are empty, contain one broadcast unit,
39 * or contain one unit per element. At most one axis in a format declares units. */
40struct SensorAxis {
41 DynamicString name;
42 DynamicArray<DynamicString> labels;
43 DynamicArray<DynamicString> units;
44
45 bool operator==(SensorAxis const& rhs) const = default;
46};
47
48inline SensorAxis MakeForceComponentAxis() {
49 return {
50 .name = "force_component",
51 .labels = {"Fx", "Fy", "Fz"},
52 .units = {"N", "N", "N"},
53 };
54}
55
56inline SensorAxis MakeWrenchComponentAxis() {
57 return {
58 .name = "wrench_component",
59 .labels = {"Fx", "Fy", "Fz", "Tx", "Ty", "Tz"},
60 .units = {"N", "N", "N", "N*m", "N*m", "N*m"},
61 };
62}
63
64/* @brief Immutable shape and meaning of one sensor's numeric output. */
65struct SensorFormat {
66 DynamicString kind;
67 DynamicArray<SensorDimension> shape;
68 SensorDType dtype = SensorDType::Float32;
69 DynamicArray<SensorAxis> axes;
70
71 bool operator==(SensorFormat const& rhs) const = default;
72};
73
74/* @brief Check @p format against the rules above and return its element count; zero with @p error
75 * set when it breaks one. */
76[[nodiscard]] MOCHI_API std::size_t GetSensorFormatElementCount(
77 SensorFormat const& format,
78 superdex::Error& error);
